bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living Tax Cuts) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2024-02-15.20.1) introduced by Groom MP [Garth Hamilton](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/groom/garth_hamilton) (LNP), which means it failed. The amendment would have changed the name of the bill. ### Motion text > *(1) Clause 1, page 1 (lines 5 and 6), omit "Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living Tax Cuts) Act 2024", substitute "Treasury Laws Amendment (Broken Promise) Act 2024".*
